facts.text: Babe from Winchestertonfieldville, Iowa, orders two.
facts.why: Winchestertonfieldville, Iowa is the made-up home of Babe's cover persona, Pam Dawson. Babe is a New York tabloid reporter.
facts.fix: Pam Dawson from Winchestertonfieldville, Iowa, orders two.

facts.text: Emilio, the butler with the foot, very, very sneaky
facts.why: The frostbitten foot is Deeds's, not Emilio's. Emilio only says its hideousness will haunt his dreams. He does say 'I am very very sneaky, sir.'
facts.fix: Emilio, the butler who is very, very sneaky

facts.text: A tuba played at the wrong moment
facts.why: Neither the plot summary nor the quote page mentions a tuba in the 2002 film.
facts.fix: Deeds's frostbitten foot breaking the ice

vibe.verdict: A real pizzeria with the right town and the right butler, but two of the lines are wrong and the biggest moments barely appear.
missing: Crazy Eyes' pizza with French fries and Oreos
Deeds saving Babe from the frozen lake with his frostbitten foot
Emilio is Blake's son and takes over the company (shareholder meeting)
The Hallmark card poem Deeds writes
Corvettes for everyone in Mandrake Falls (finale)
Deeds beating up the thieves who mock him (Babe's purse)
ideas: Rename 'Greeting card cheese and tomato pinwheels' to 'Hallmark pinwheels' with a poem on a toothpick flag.
Swap 'Cola float with whipped cream' for 'Crazy Eyes' fries and Oreos float'.
Replace the foot line on the baked ziti with 'Emilio is very, very sneaky, sir'.
Add a corvette red cherry to the pie case: 'Corvette cherry cheesecake' for the finale.
